text:
Most agent demos are theater. The prompt is doing ten percent of the work and the eval suite is doing none of it.
I do not trust a demo I can run once. I trust the one I can run a hundred times and still want to read the log.
Consistency is not a personality trait of the model. It is a property of the system you built around it.
Show me your retries, your timeouts, your failure paths. That is where the actual product lives.
Tell me I am wrong.
